_comment: Safety thresholds. Loaded by brim at startup (device/src/common/config.cpp); missing keys fall back to safe defaults so the hat always boots. There is no distance sensor: proximity is estimated from how much of the frame a box fills, so these are area fractions, not metres. info_min_interval_s is floored at 10 and track_forget_s capped at 1800 in code (spec rules).
